metadata.title: Monochrome Band Portrait with Shadowed Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, grainy black and white group portrait of four men in white shirts against a deep black background, featuring centered, stacked typography at the top with a distinct hard-edged drop shadow.
coreVisualRelationships: White shirts contrasting against a void-like black background
Centered text hierarchy balanced above a staggered group composition
Grainy film texture unifying the photographic and graphic elements
Direct, neutral eye contact creating a somber, serious tone
coreInvariants: High-contrast lighting that washes out shirt details
Hard, offset drop shadows on all text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged in two rows; two in the foreground, two slightly behind, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central text block at the top center acts as the primary anchor for the vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold top text, moves down to the faces of the subjects, and settles on the bright white of their shirts.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space at the top and sides creates a sense of isolation and focus.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white shirts and text faces
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays in skin tones and hair texture
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.
paletteRestrictions: No smooth gradients in the background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, rounded sans-serif and geometric display faces
letterConstructionRules: Rounded terminals on the primary display line
Hard, sharp-edged drop shadows offset to the bottom right
characterSpecificRedesigns: The primary title features a 'W' with intersecting strokes
Secondary text uses a more condensed, geometric sans-serif
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy rounded display paired with a lighter, wider-tracked geometric sub-header.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the rounded, thick geometry of the primary text.
Matches the geometric, clean look of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy black and white photograph of four men with long 70s-style hair wearing plain white t-shirts. They should be standing in a staggered group against a solid black background, looking directly at the camera with neutral expressions. The top third of the image should be empty black space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered white uppercase text in the top black area. The first line should be a heavy rounded sans-serif. The second line should be a condensed geometric sans-serif with wider tracking. Apply a hard-edged black drop shadow to both lines, offset slightly to the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is there a hard drop shadow on the text?
Are the shirts bright white against a black background?

mustRedesign: Original band name and album title text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color artifacts are present.
Check that the text shadow is hard-edged, not blurred.
Verify the subjects are wearing plain white shirts.
Confirm the composition leaves enough negative space at the top.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W photography + Staggered group portrait + Heavy rounded display type with hard drop shadows + Grainy texture overlay.
